                    ### Question
                    In which of the following pathological states would the oxygen content of the trachea resemble the oxygen content in the affected alveoli?

                    ### Options
                    opa. Emphysema
opb. Pulmonary fibrosis
opc. Pulmonary embolism
opd. Foreign body obstruction distal to the trachea
ope. Exercise

### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
In the pathological states of Emphysema, Pulmonary Fibrosis, Pulmonary Embolism, and Foreign body obstruction distal to the trachea, the oxygen content of the trachea would resemble the oxygen content in the affected alveoli due to impaired gas exchange. Exercise, on the other hand, would lead to enhanced gas exchange in alveoli, causing the oxygen content in the trachea to differ from affected alveoli.
